title: PAR-116 AC1024 HATCH zero-fit tangent witness screen
scope: Reconcile the ODA R2010 HATCH spline field sequence with the local nfit-gated tangent parser
Screen locally present AC1024 drawings under tests/samples for a traceable HATCH spline boundary witness
Avoid promoting external or same-stack evidence into a support claim

normativeSource.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
normativeSource.observation: R24 lists Numfitpoints, the repeated fit-point payload, Start tangent, and End tangent in sequence; the published pseudocode does not condition the two tangent fields on a nonzero fit count.

localParser.observation: The R2010+ parser reads the fit count and reads both 2RD tangents only when nfit > 0. Its comment cites ACadSharp behavior and a zero-fit spline boundary in svg/export_sample.dwg as the compatibility reason.

corpusScreen.gitTrackingState: The ten files under tests/samples/AC1024 are untracked in this worktree; their repository provenance is not inferred.
corpusScreen.traceObservation: The ten debug conversions produced no HATCH boundary-spline/tangent trace marker. The condominium sample showed a general spline parser marker, not a HATCH boundary-spline record. All ten dwg2dxf attempts declined strict-complete export because unsupported custom classes were observed; this does not imply the DWG parser itself failed.
corpusScreen.userLocalAc1024Inventory: Nine files under ~/doc/dwg were identified by their AC1024 header; they were not rerun in this screen.

disposition.finding: PAR-116 / 7N.3 remains unresolved for zero-fit HATCH spline tangent presence.

nextAction: Do not change the nfit gate based on the schema alone or on same-stack peer behavior. Resume only with a locally generated or provenance-cleared AC1024 producer witness whose tangent bytes and record boundary are independently verified; keep other local-ready work moving in parallel.
